title: Understanding Hidden Spatial Preferences in Bayesian Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.14696v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian optimization uses posterior uncertainty to decide where to explore, but this uncertainty is not spatially neutral. On bounded domains, Gaussian-process posterior variance is typically larger near faces, edges, and corners, giving variance-based acquisition functions a systematic boundary bias. This spatial preference is usually inherited from the surrogate rather than chosen as part of the exploration strategy. We separate these roles by keeping the predictive model fixed and modifying the spatial preference of the exploration term. We control the preference with spatial weight fields and amortize their construction with neural surrogates. Controlled experiments show that the Gaussian process' default boundary bias changes which parts of the domain are explored and which optima are reached. translated_title: 理解贝叶斯优化中隐藏的空间偏好
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯优化利用后验不确定性来决定在何处进行探索，但这种不确定性在空间上并非中立的。在有界域上，高斯过程的后验方差通常在面、边和角附近更大，这使得基于方差的采集函数产生系统性的边界偏差。这种空间偏好通常是从代理模型中继承而来的，而非作为探索策略的一部分被有意选择。我们通过保持预测模型固定并修改探索项的空间偏好，将这两种角色分离开来。我们使用空间权重场来控制这种偏好，并借助神经代理模型来摊销其构建成本。受控实验表明，高斯过程默认的边界偏差会改变域中哪些区域被探索以及哪些最优解被找到。我们比较了三种替代的探索原则，并在标准基准函数和随机机器人推动任务中发现……
tldr: 贝叶斯优化中基于方差的探索策略会继承高斯过程代理模型固有的系统性边界偏差，该研究通过空间权重场将空间偏好与预测模型分离并加以控制，实验证明这种隐藏的空间偏好会显著影响探索区域的分布和最终找到的最优解。
en_tdlr: Variance-based exploration in Bayesian optimization inherits a systematic boundary bias from the Gaussian-process surrogate; by decoupling and controlling this hidden spatial preference with spatial weight fields, the authors show it significantly shapes which regions are explored and which optima are reached.
